Hi, Ender,
Thanks for your information.
1. For those 3 units, it is Layer 2+, not L3
We can provide L3 models as you may notice from the links.
But still
PIM-SM/DM and RIPng/PBR are the main issue.
It is just NOT available with the current chipset solution.
This info can be found in Saga Software Function List_7.3, 7.4, 7.5 version.

In the meantime, I talked with different AIs, GPT or GEMINI
Conclusion is, it is just not easy to have a suitable model even from Moxa
or any famous brand.
This project is about an industrial grade access switch, L3 managed.
For most industrial models, L3 features(PIM-SM/DM and RIPng/PBR) are the
problem.
For CENTEC models, L3 features are OK, but temperature is not working.
Awkward

2. Yes please and thanks for your efforts.
Please read the feature/model list or talk with me if there is any query or
project available.
Thank you.

probably reason 2.

When PoE board starts to function, it requires much power to be activated.
It is possible that your battery is not feeding enough power

to even 1 single PD(TPLINK AP)

2.2: And what is the input voltage?
It should be DC48V, maybe the input voltage is too low?

Remove your battery for now.
Eg: MEAN WELL NDR-240-48

yes, then it is your power system problem.
no, we should get ready for remote control via anydesk, we will check the
configuration etc.

2. Please send videos of the connection, your power system, port status etc.

It should be videos, this is very direct and easy to know the problems.
Text is not informative enough.

After talking with our engineer, this is a chip problem.
The version you used is AC3, an old version.

1. it will be available on this model next month.

Difference
AC3 platform: based on an older Linux environment from the original SDK
Linux 3.x
Debian 7
It just supports limited terminal types.

AC5 platform: use a much newer embedded Linux built with Buildroot
2023.08.1, which includes updated toolchains and broader terminal
compatibility.
NAME=Buildroot VERSION=-g27249132 ID=buildroot VERSION_ID=2023.08.1
PRETTY_NAME="Buildroot 2023.08.1"
Its SDK adopts
new toolchain
new linux kernel
new ncurses
full terminfo
Therefore modern terminal types such as xterm-256color are supported.

Please go on with your testing, and let me know the PoE issues or more.
When your testing is done, let's discuss or just talk about AC5.
Thank you.

Sayın İş Ortağımız,

Süregelen destekleriniz için iş ortaklarımıza teşekkür ederiz. Herhangi bir sorunuz olması halinde bizimle iletişime geçmekten lütfen çekinmeyiniz.

We have pleasure in sending you 2025 Export Control Compliance Management Commitment Statement and 2025 Export Control Compliance Policy.

This past year, our company made significant advancements in export control compliance program. We believe these compliance construction measures will help to maintain a sound relationship with you.

Thanks our business partners for the continued support. If you have questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Best regards!

Netaş Compliance Department
